title: task.updated payload
description: Emitted by Notifications & Messaging when a task changes state (completed, forwarded/reassigned, cancelled). Consumed by the WebSocket service, BMS (to advance a waiting human step), and Logging.

by.description: User id who effected the change.

forwardedTo.description: New assignee when state is forwarded.

outcome.description: For a completed decision task: the verdict, e.g. "approved"/"rejected".
